product_metadata.title: Cactus Canyon Ceramics Spanish Terracotta 2 Quart Pitcher, Green
features: SANGRIA PITCHER: Perfect for parties and entertaining, or everyday use!, this multi-colored terracotta pitcher holds approximately two quarts and stands ten inches tall. Sturdy and hand-thrown.
MADE IN SPAIN: This water pitcher is hand-painted in Andalusia, Spain. It serves as both a decorative ceramic as well as a functional kitchen accessory making it a great gift for any home.
TERRACOTTA: Explore this decorative and durable ceramics for your kitchen, tabletop and entertaining needs. These vibrant designs will maintain their color. Dishwasher, microwave and food safe.
EUROPEAN FLAIR: Hand-painted by artisans in Spain, these rustic home decor items include dinnerware sets, cups, breakfast, salsa & pinch bowls, tapas & dinner plates plus patio & garden pieces.
CACTUS CANYON CERAMICS: We are a small business dedicated to providing premium quality, extra virgin olive oil, hand-painted pottery and other special and unique items to our customer.
